sections.title: ☁️ Cloud & Infrastructure
sections.summary: The sources indicate that Kubernetes employs rolling updates as its default deployment strategy, which allows for gradual replacement of old pods with new ones to ensure zero-downtime upgrades. This strategy is highlighted in various contexts, including a guide on live cluster updates, a DevOps tutorial, and a video demonstration. Rolling updates are emphasized as a key concept for production Kubernetes workloads, ensuring applications remain available during deployments. The sources also mention that Kubernetes handles the release with built-in rolling updates and health checks, and that this method fits most everyday releases, especially for stateless web apps and APIs.
